import json
import time
import requests
from kubernetes import client, config
from langchain_core.tools import tool


def _record_alert(namespace, deployment, ready, want, status_code):
    entry = {
        'ts': time.time(),
        'namespace': namespace,
        'deployment': deployment,
        'ready': ready,
        'desired': want,
        'status_code': status_code,
    }
    with open('alert_history.jsonl', 'a') as f:
        f.write(json.dumps(entry) + '\n')


@tool
def post_deployment_alert_to_slack(namespace: str, deployment: str, webhook_url: str, note: str='') -> str:
    config.load_kube_config()
    apps = client.AppsV1Api()
    dep = apps.read_namespaced_deployment_status(deployment, namespace)
    st = dep.status
    want = dep.spec.replicas or 0
    ready = st.ready_replicas or 0
    avail = st.available_replicas or 0
    text = f':warning: *{namespace}/{deployment}* has {ready}/{want} ready, {avail} available, {st.unavailable_replicas or 0} unavailable.'
    if note:
        text += f'\n{note}'
    r = requests.post(webhook_url, json={'text': text}, timeout=10)
    r.raise_for_status()
    _record_alert(namespace, deployment, ready, want, r.status_code)
    return f'Alert sent ({r.status_code}) for {namespace}/{deployment}'
